messages:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: were activating the review-exception flow for late submissions + LOA edgecases. Please read before you reassign or approve any extensions.

Leila: Thanks Sam. Quick Q  if a reviewer is >48h late but already left notes, do we auto-assign a backup or wait for them?

Sam (People Ops): If >48h and no response, auto-assign backup. Well attempt 1 DM + 1 email before reassign. Backup pool = reviewers listed on the teams fallback rota.

Chris: Can backups be external reviewers (contractors)? We have one team with a contractor reviewer who might be better suited than a random backup.

Sam (People Ops): Contractors allowed if theyre on the contractor-reviewer list and completed the quick-conflict training. If not, assign internal backup and flag for exceptions@people-ops.

Evan: What about LOA where reviewer is out for two weeks? Were mid-cycle, forms open, can the assignee transfer responsibility without changing form lock?

Sam (People Ops): Yes: use the transfer workflow (Form -> "Transfer reviewer" button) and paste the handoff note in the comment. Form locks remain unchanged. Include: handoff reason, dates, and any incomplete comments.

Priya: Is there a strict cutoff for extension approvals? Some managers are asking for timezone-limited samples.

Sam (People Ops): Extensions allowed up to 72h in documented emergencies. Anything beyond requires VP-level approval and recorded in the approval sheet. No rubric or score changes due to extension.

Leila: Who is on the escalation for VP approvals? I only see Ops leads listed.

Sam (People Ops): Escalation list: @HeadPeopleOps, @VP-Product (delegates ok), and on-call People Ops lead. If you ping #people-ops-escalations it routes to the right approver.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: "Review exception approvals due" in 24h for teams with >10% late items.

Chris: One more  when backups are assigned, do we re-run calibration sampling for that reviewer block?

Sam (People Ops): Yes: any reassigned reviews are added to the next calibration sample batch for that manager. Add the tag "reassigned" in the form so sampling scripts pick it up.

Evan: Copy that. Ill update the team rota and add the contractor reviewer to the approved list (Leila will follow up with training link).

Priya: Thanks 44D will there be a short FAQ we can forward to managers?

Sam (People Ops): Yep 44C Ill drop a 1-pager + the approval sheet link in #people-ops-resources in 30m. Use it for manager comms.

Leila: tagging ops to update contractor list now.

Sam (People Ops): Great teamwork. If anyone runs into a weird edgecase, DM me directly.
